name: Supabase Auth
tagline: GoTrue-based HTTP auth for signup, sessions, MFA, and OAuth
description: Supabase Auth is a hosted GoTrue authentication API that handles user signup, login, session management, MFA, and OAuth for apps built on Supabase. Developers call project-scoped Auth endpoints with the anon or service role key to manage identities and JWTs.

auth.details: Project API keys via apikey header and Authorization: Bearer <anon|service_role JWT>; self-serve project signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan includes Auth with project limits; verify current MAU/bandwidth on pricing page
pricing.paid_plans: Pro and higher with higher MAU and features

use_cases: sign up a user with email/password
